name: Field-emission SEM
purpose: Inspect electrode contacts, shanks and surfaces.
geometryBrief: Electron column, chamber door, stage, detectors, vacuum hardware and screen.
behaviorBrief: Beam raster, sample tilt and calibrated image source; not a generic photo filter.
inputs: Surface or referenced SEM field, specimen pose, raster sampling and detector/image calibration
outputs: SEM raster, specimen-space transform, pixel spacing and source modality
acceptance: Rasterize a reference grating at normal incidence and a known tilt. In the orthographic fixture its projected pitch along the tilted dimension should scale by the cosine of the tilt.

name: FIB-SEM
purpose: Serial milling and imaging for 3D neural and material volumes.
geometryBrief: Two angled columns, chamber, motorized stage, detector and console.
behaviorBrief: Represent slice-and-image sequence; load real or synthetic voxel stack, record anisotropy.
inputs: Voxel block ID, milling-plane pose, section increment and in-plane pixel spacing
outputs: Ordered slice images, anisotropic voxel spacing and block-to-image transform
acceptance: Sample a synthetic block containing a diagonal wire. Reconstructed endpoints should agree in physical coordinates with the original wire within one voxel along each axis.

name: Plasma FIB-SEM
geometryBrief: Dual-column assembly, chamber, transfer ports and controller.
behaviorBrief: Material removal and 3D inspection at separately calibrated scale; do not assume biological sample readiness.
inputs: Material-block geometry, registered virtual cut volume, SEM view and removal-scale calibration
outputs: Revised block geometry, removed volume, exposed-face image and parent revision
acceptance: Subtract a rectangular prism fully inside a homogeneous synthetic block. The removed volume should equal its three dimensions multiplied together within discretization error and the resulting face should lie on the commanded plane.

name: Serial block-face SEM
purpose: Serial block-face imaging of prepared biological samples.
geometryBrief: SEM chamber, internal microtome schematic, block holder and workstation.
behaviorBrief: Advance virtual section stack; contrast, missing slices and registration.
inputs: Prepared virtual block or reference stack, section indices, frame shifts and contrast metadata
outputs: Registered block-face stack, missing-section mask, transforms and voxel spacing
acceptance: Shift a fiducial stack by known in-plane offsets and omit a slice. Alignment should recover fiducial positions and retain the missing physical z position in the metadata.

name: TEM
geometryBrief: Tall column, specimen holder, viewing/camera section, vacuum rack and console.
behaviorBrief: Projection of sections, contrast and scale; no invented nanoscale observations.
inputs: Thin-section volume or reference TEM image, section pose, pixel pitch and contrast model
outputs: Projection image, dimensional scale, contrast-model ID and source section ID
acceptance: Under a declared linear projection approximation, two identical overlapping synthetic density layers should double the projected density compared with one layer. Check lateral dimensions against the phantom.

name: Cryo-TEM
purpose: Specialized cryogenic ultrastructural and molecular imaging.
geometryBrief: Tall column, cryo-loading enclosure, racks and workstation.
behaviorBrief: Reference cryo-image workflow and reconstruction; not necessary for all nerve-interface studies.
inputs: Archived cryo-EM image set or projection fixture, acquisition metadata, pixel size and orientation data where applicable
outputs: Indexed reference images, reconstruction volume when supported, voxel scale and source dataset provenance
acceptance: Reconstruct supplied projections of a phantom with known handed orientation. Check landmark spacings and handedness against the reference and preserve the source image IDs.

name: Ultramicrotome
purpose: Prepare thin sections for electron microscopy.
geometryBrief: Base, specimen arm, diamond knife holder, binoculars and controls.
behaviorBrief: Section thickness and specimen geometry, with missing-section flags.
inputs: Block ID, cutting axis, virtual section thickness, serial order and loss flags
outputs: Thin-section child IDs, each with index, physical depth and collection status
acceptance: Remove the middle section of a five-section fixture. Four collected IDs should remain while physical depth and serial numbering retain the gap.

name: High-pressure freezer
geometryBrief: Enclosure, sample loading area and control panel.
behaviorBrief: Preservation method metadata; no real preparation steps.
inputs: Virtual specimen ID, prior state and preservation-method record
outputs: Preserved-specimen revision, timestamp, method and provenance
acceptance: Apply a preservation event to a labeled specimen. The new revision should cite the input and method while preserving coordinates and leaving unspecified ultrastructure unknown.
geometryStatus: First pass: metric dormant exterior with published overall body and station envelope
simulationStatus: First pass: detached inert outline annotation only; preservation acceptance deferred
integrationStatus: First pass: simulator route, metric GLB, named exhibit action and annotation example

name: Freeze substitution unit
behaviorBrief: Preparation state and provenance, no detailed chemistry.
inputs: Preserved-specimen revision, abstract preparation event and provenance
outputs: Post-substitution specimen revision with ordered preparation history
acceptance: Pass the preserved output from 13-08 through the event. The resulting specimen should retain both method records in order and trace back to the same source ID.

name: High vacuum coater
purpose: Coat selected specimens for EM imaging.
geometryBrief: Vacuum chamber, hinged lid, deposition sources and panel.
behaviorBrief: Conductive layer metadata and thickness; no unsupported effect on biological detail.
inputs: Specimen surface ID, coating material, modeled film thickness (m) and coverage mask
outputs: Coating-layer revision with thickness, coverage and parent specimen link
acceptance: Use a planar coupon and a rectangular coverage mask. Measured film step should match prescribed thickness within mesh resolution, and the uncoated area should retain its original height.

name: Critical-point dryer
purpose: Represent preparation of appropriate samples for SEM.
behaviorBrief: Drying state, shrinkage assumptions and sample lineage.
inputs: Virtual specimen geometry, drying event and optional uniform shrinkage factor
outputs: Dried specimen revision, transformed geometry when enabled, shrinkage assumption and parent ID
acceptance: Use a cube with linear shrinkage factor s. Edge lengths should scale by s and volume by s³; with s equal to one the geometry should remain identical.

name: Glow discharge cleaner
purpose: Represent surface treatment of microscopy grids.
geometryBrief: Small enclosure, vacuum chamber and control panel.
behaviorBrief: Grid surface state; no operating chemistry.
inputs: Microscopy grid ID, initial surface-state metadata and abstract treatment event
outputs: Grid revision with updated treatment state, timestamp and original grid geometry
acceptance: Apply the event to one of two virtual grids. Only that grid should receive the surface-state entry; mesh topology and scale should be preserved for both.

name: Cryostat
purpose: Prepare frozen tissue sections for histology.
geometryBrief: Cabinet, cold chamber, microtome controls and stage.
behaviorBrief: Section plane and thickness; link sections to 3D sample.
inputs: Frozen specimen volume, cutting-plane pose, section thickness and destination slide IDs
outputs: Child section images, parent-volume transforms, slab depths and slide assignments
acceptance: Cut through an oblique fiducial in a digital phantom. The section intercept should shift by the analytically expected amount with depth and map back to the parent line within voxel resolution.

name: Rotary microtome
geometryBrief: Handwheel, specimen holder, blade holder and section tray.
behaviorBrief: Section geometry, thickness and serial index.
inputs: Embedded virtual block, cutting orientation, thickness, starting index and collection list
outputs: Serial section geometries, order, physical depth and block lineage
acceptance: Generate a ribbon of equal-thickness sections from a calibrated block. Successive center depths should differ by the selected thickness, with unique indices and an unchanged parent reference.

name: Micro-CT
purpose: Inspect small specimens, implants and anatomical hard tissue.
geometryBrief: Shielded chamber, rotary stage, source/detector geometry and console.
behaviorBrief: Projection/reconstruction model or real CT data; voxel scale and artifacts explicit.
inputs: Attenuation phantom or real projection set, projection geometry, angles and detector pitch
outputs: CT volume, voxel spacing, reconstruction transform and artifact/coverage metadata
acceptance: Project and reconstruct a synthetic two-bead phantom of known separation. Check center spacing against physical ground truth within reconstruction resolution and flag an intentionally incomplete rotation.
